description: Substrates in use at this laboratory. A fitting job names one id; the preset names the default. Densities are bulk literature values unless the provenance says otherwise; sigma_A is this laboratory's stock polish and is a starting value, not a material property.

si.provenance: Density is the standard bulk value for single-crystal silicon. sigma_A is this laboratory's usual polished-wafer starting value; not measured per batch.
si.note: Polished Si wafer. A native oxide of 10-20 A is present on any wafer not etched immediately before deposition; model it as a separate SiO2 layer when the fit calls for it rather than folding it into sigma.

sio2-fused.provenance: Bulk literature value for fused silica. Not measured at this laboratory.
sio2-fused.note: Fused silica / synthetic quartz glass. Distinct from crystalline quartz (2.65) and from soda-lime glass (~2.5).

quartz-crystalline.note: Crystalline alpha-quartz. This is the value procedure v4 carried for what it called a glass substrate, which was an error; see soda-lime-glass.

soda-lime-glass.provenance: NOT MEASURED. Conventional density of soda-lime silicate glass: ISO 16293-1:2008, Glass in building - Basic soda lime silicate glass products - Part 1: Definitions and general physical and mechanical properties, clause 5.1, Table 1, 'Density (at 18 degC) 2 500 kg/m3', given there as a generally accepted figure 'where a high degree of accuracy is not required', not a requirement (identical in EN 572-1:2004, clause 6.1, Table 1). Ground C (convention). The composition below is a typical float-glass analysis within the ranges of ISO 16293-1 clause 4.1, not an analysis of this laboratory's stock, which is bought on Taobao without a product datasheet (author, 2026-09-21), so no supplier value can replace the convention.
soda-lime-glass.table_entry_hint: Not in the stock Henke table; add it. Typical soda-lime float glass by weight: SiO2 72.6, Na2O 13.9, CaO 8.4, MgO 3.9, Al2O3 1.2. Weighted (Z/A)eff is about 0.494 against SiO2's 0.4993, so modelling it as SiO2 at 2.50 reproduces the electron density to roughly one per cent if a table entry is not available.
soda-lime-glass.note: The substrate of this laboratory's XRF and XRR multilayer specimens. sigma_A 3.8 is the value procedure v4 used.

sapphire.provenance: Bulk literature value for single-crystal alpha-Al2O3. Not measured at this laboratory.
sapphire.table_entry_hint: Not in the stock Henke table; add it. Formula Al2O3, bulk density 3.98 g/cm3.

si3n4.provenance: Henke stock table bulk value. sigma_A assumed, not measured.
si3n4.note: Silicon nitride membrane or coated wafer.

sic.provenance: Henke stock table bulk value. sigma_A assumed, not measured.
